questions: Should the function follow redirects automatically (mechanize's default behavior) or should it treat redirects differently (e.g., raise an error, return links from the final URL)?
Should the function handle relative URLs that are not from <a> tags (e.g., from <link>, <area>, or <base> tags)?
Should the function handle malformed href values (e.g., containing spaces, JavaScript, or mailto) by skipping them, including them as-is, or raising an error?
Should the function handle duplicate links (same absolute URL from different hrefs) by returning duplicates or deduplicating?
Should the function handle URLs that are already absolute (e.g., starting with http://) differently from relative ones during urljoin?
Should the function include hyperlinks from nested frames or iframes within the HTML?
Should the function handle authentication-required pages or cookies set by mechanize before fetching?
Should the function handle timeouts or network errors by retrying, raising an exception, or returning an empty list?
